milestone.piece: Separate historical admission and retirement proof adapter
milestone.invariant: An inherited retired account needs its own checked original admission and a separately confirmed later retirement preserving its exact archived target. Successor support cannot fill missing original proof; current/held records and never-active withdrawal operations cannot become retired-account evidence.
milestone.observable_pass: Both dispute and material correction/withdrawal histories select the exact old result, original source catalogue/review and distinct retirement effect/review, with a closed locator and dependency digest. Missing legacy original proof is unoffered; modern tampering of either owner, source, result, bounds, preservation or operation evidence fails before offering history.

Shared original admission resolution verifies chronological sources and committed original-prefix executions once per adapter invocation, then current and historical adapters select separate stage-owned results. Historical entries carry detached original support, existing preservation proof and closed supplier locators bound by inherited_history_dependency_v1 digest. Original local IDs and all existing durable v1 receipts/seals remain unchanged.

Then native options, verifier/admission handoffs, full/mixed source extent and actual browser qualification. Inherited withdrawal-operation coverage remains a distinct owner if requested; this helper certifies retired account records only. Other six-activity gaps remain open.
